title: Pizarro captures the Inca emperor Atahualpa at Cajamarca
summary: Francisco Pizarro's small Spanish force ambushed the escort of the Inca ruler Atahualpa in the main square of Cajamarca, killed thousands and took him prisoner.
reason: Pizarro aimed to conquer the Inca Empire for its gold, and Atahualpa had just won a civil war against his brother Huascar.
significance: It began the Spanish conquest of the Inca Empire, the largest state in the Americas.
